formats.key: createLegacyV2((address user, uint256 percent)[] distributions_, (uint256 lackOfOutgoingTxRange, uint256 delayLayer2, uint256 delayLayer3) extraConfig_, (address user, uint256 percent) layer2Distribution_, (address user, uint256 percent) layer3Distribution_, (((address token, uint160 amount, uint48 expiration, uint48 nonce)[] details, address spender, uint256 sigDeadline) permitBatch, bytes signature) permit2_, uint256 signatureTimestamp, bytes agreementSignature)
effects: Deploys a new legacy contract owned by the signer and marks the signer as having a legacy (only one is allowed).
Sets the main beneficiaries and their shares, the inactivity period, and up to two backup beneficiaries with their shares and delays.
Records the signer's consent to the 10102 terms, either through the signature or from the transaction itself.
Calls PERMIT2.permit, which writes Permit2 allowances for each listed token, amount and expiry to the spender. The code forces the spender to be the pull vault or the new legacy.
Binds the signer to the new legacy in the pull vault, so that legacy can later pull the signer's tokens through Permit2 when a beneficiary claims.
formats.shown: Create legacy, approve tokens: the beneficiaries with their shares, the inactivity period, the backups with their shares and delays, and each Permit2 token with its amount (Unlimited at the max) and expiry, plus the spender.

findings.title: createLegacyV2 durations render as hours (4320:00:00), not days.
findings.evidence: descriptor extraConfig_.lackOfOutgoingTxRange format duration; case 0 shows 'Inactivity period' '4320:00:00' for 180 days
findings.fix: No day-based duration format exists in the spec. A label hint such as 'Inactivity period (hours)' would help.

findings.title: createLegacyV2 backup shares use an enum with only 0 and 100%. Any other percent would have no label.
findings.evidence: metadata.enums.backupShare {"0":"None","1000000":"100%"}; layer2Distribution_.percent format enum. The clone's validation is not in the directory.
findings.fix: Use format unit with base % and decimals 4, as the main shares do. Or confirm that the clone only accepts 0 or 1000000.

effects: Resets the inactivity timer of the signer's legacy (clone activeAlive(msg.sender)).
Triggers the premium owner-reset reminder and refills the auto-renew budget if auto-renew is on.
Sets a new inactivity period for the signer's legacy. After this period, beneficiaries can claim.
formats.shown: Change inactivity period: the legacy id and the new period in hours.

findings.title: setActivationTrigger has no interpolatedIntent, so the new period is missing from the sentence.
findings.evidence: descriptor setActivationTrigger: intent 'Change inactivity period', no interpolatedIntent
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Set inactivity period of legacy {legacyId_} to {lackOfOutgoingTxRange_}'.

formats.key: setLegacyDistributions(uint256 legacyId_, string[] nickNames_, (address user, uint256 percent)[] distributions_)
effects: Replaces the main beneficiary list and shares of the signer's legacy. Nicknames are ignored.
formats.shown: Change beneficiaries: the legacy id and each new beneficiary with their share.

formats.key: setLayer23Distributions(uint256 legacyId_, uint8 layer_, string nickname_, (address user, uint256 percent) distribution_)
effects: Sets the first or second backup beneficiary and share of the signer's legacy.
formats.shown: Change backup beneficiary: which backup, the address and the share.

formats.key: setBothLayer23Distributions(uint256 legacyId_, string layer2Nickname_, (address user, uint256 percent) layer2Distribution_, string layer3Nickname_, (address user, uint256 percent) layer3Distribution_)
effects: Sets both backup beneficiaries and their shares on the signer's legacy.
formats.shown: Change backup beneficiaries: both backups with their shares.

formats.key: setLegacyConfig(uint256 legacyId_, (string name, string note, string[] nickNames, (address user, uint256 percent)[] distributions) mainConfig_, (uint256 lackOfOutgoingTxRange, uint256 delayLayer2, uint256 delayLayer3) extraConfig_, (address user, uint256 percent) layer2Distribution_, (address user, uint256 percent) layer3Distribution_, string layer2Nickname_, string layer3Nickname_)
effects: Replaces the main beneficiaries and shares.
Sets a new inactivity period.
Sets the backup delays and both backup beneficiaries with their shares. Name, note and nicknames are ignored.
formats.shown: Update legacy: the beneficiaries and shares, the inactivity period, both backups with their shares and delays.

findings.title: setLegacyConfig intent 'Update legacy' does not say that beneficiaries and the timer are replaced.
findings.evidence: descriptor setLegacyConfig intent 'Update legacy'. The router calls setLegacyDistributions, setActivationTrigger and setDelayAndLayer23Distributions.
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Replace beneficiaries, backups and inactivity period'.

effects: Turns auto-renewal on or off. When on, the 10102 attestor can push back the inactivity deadline, based on the signer's wallet activity, for up to 365 days after the last real check-in.
formats.shown: Set automatic renewal: the legacy id and true/false.

findings.title: setAutoRenew does not say that an off-chain attestor, not the signer, renews the timer.
findings.evidence: TransferLegacyEOAContractRouter.sol recordActivity: only activityAttestor may call activeAlive(owner). The descriptor says only 'Automatic renewal on'.
findings.fix: Use a label like 'Let 10102 renew from wallet activity'.

effects: Allows or forbids relayed, gas-free claims by beneficiaries (sponsoredClaimsDisabled = !enabled_).
formats.shown: Set gas-free claims: the legacy id and true/false.

formats.key: autoSwap(uint256 legacyId_, (address storageToken, uint256 amountOutMin, uint256 deadline) swap_)
effects: Sends msg.value ETH from the signer to the legacy clone.
The clone swaps the ETH for storageToken on Uniswap V2, or wraps it when the token is WETH, and sends the tokens to the owner's wallet (router comment; the clone source is missing).
Probably records storageToken as the legacy's storage token, which unswap and activeLegacyAndUnswap use later (clone source missing).
formats.shown: Convert ETH to a token: the ETH amount, the token received, a minimum labeled 'Swap min (not WETH)', the deadline and the legacy id.

findings.title: autoSwap minimum is labeled 'Swap min (not WETH)' yet renders in WETH, which contradicts the label.
findings.evidence: descriptor autoSwap swap_.amountOutMin label 'Swap min (not WETH)'; case 13 shows 'Swap min (not WETH)' '0.5 WETH'
findings.fix: Use the label 'Minimum received' and say elsewhere that it is ignored when wrapping to WETH.

findings.title: autoSwap: where the tokens go and whether the storage token is recorded is unverifiable without the clone source.
findings.evidence: TransferLegacyEOAContractRouter.sol autoSwap forwards to ITransferEOALegacy(legacyAddress).autoSwap{value: msg.value}(msg.sender, swap_). The clone is not in the directory.
findings.fix: Verify the clone implementation and state the recipient in the intent if it is not the signer.

formats.key: unswap(uint256 legacyId_, uint256 amountIn_, uint256 amountOutMin_, uint256 deadline_)
effects: Pulls amountIn_ of the legacy's stored storage token from the signer's wallet (per the router comment).
Swaps it to ETH and sends at least amountOutMin_ ETH to the signer.
formats.shown: Convert back to ETH: the legacy id, a raw token amount in base units, the minimum ETH and the deadline.

findings.title: unswap shows the token amount raw and never names the token, because the token is in the clone's storage.
findings.evidence: TransferLegacyEOAContractRouter.sol unswap: storageToken = ITransferEOALegacy(legacyAddress).eoaStorageToken(). descriptor amountIn_ format raw; case 14 shows '500000000000000000'.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. The label already warns about base units.

effects: The clone withdraws amount_ to the signer, presumably ETH held by the legacy. The clone source is missing.
formats.shown: Withdraw ETH from legacy: the legacy id and an ETH amount.

findings.title: withdraw: the asset and recipient cannot be checked because the clone's withdraw source is missing.

effects: Deletes the signer's legacy in the clone and clears the signer's create flag. Any asset movement in the clone's deleteLegacy cannot be checked.

formats.key: activeLegacy(uint256 legacyId_, address[] assets_, bool isETH_)
effects: Activates the legacy, a one-way change that ends the owner's legacy and clears the owner's create flag.
The clone pulls the listed tokens, and ETH if isETH_, from the owner and pays the signer's allocated share. The amounts depend on owner balances and stored shares.
formats.shown: Claim legacy: the legacy id, each token claimed and whether ETH is included.

findings.title: activeLegacy: claimed amounts come from owner balances and stored shares, so they cannot be shown.

formats.key: activeLegacyAndUnswap(uint256 legacyId_, address[] assets_, uint256 amountOutMin_, uint256 deadline_)
effects: Activates the legacy and claims the listed tokens for the signer.
Swaps the owner's storage token back to ETH with at least amountOutMin_ ETH, and distributes it.
formats.shown: Claim legacy as ETH: the legacy id, the tokens claimed, a minimum ETH labeled 'Swap min (not WETH)' and the deadline.

findings.title: activeLegacyAndUnswap intent 'Claim legacy as ETH' suggests every asset becomes ETH. Only the storage token is swapped.
findings.evidence: router devdoc: 'if the owner has an active storage-token swap, it is atomically swapped back to ETH'. Other assets_ are claimed as tokens.
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Claim legacy, swap storage token to ETH'.

findings.title: activeLegacyAndUnswap minimum label 'Swap min (not WETH)' is cryptic.
findings.evidence: descriptor amountOutMin_ label 'Swap min (not WETH)'; case 18 shows '0.99 ETH'
findings.fix: Use the label 'Minimum ETH from swap'.

couldNotCheck: The legacy clone implementation (router storage legacyImplementation, or legacyCreationCode) is not in the directory. Every asset movement of withdraw, autoSwap, unswap, deleteLegacy, activeLegacy and activeLegacyAndUnswap runs there.
The LegacyPullVault (router storage pullVault) is not in the directory. createLegacyV2 binds the signer in it, and it executes the Permit2 pulls at claim time.
